title: Master Safety Chain to CR407
description: Full upstream permissive path required to energize CR407.
failureEffect: Loss of any node drops CR407 and removes refrigeration safety permissive.

title: NH3 Shutdown to CR407
description: Machine room NH3 shutdown path from RC-7 to CR437 and then CR407.
failureEffect: Machine room NH3 alarm or relay fault drops CR407.

title: HTR1 High Level to CR407
description: HTR1 high-level path that opens the master safety relay chain.
failureEffect: HTR1 high level or false high-level fault drops CR407.
firstCheck: Verify actual HTR1 level, then FS5011.

title: LTR1 High Level to CR407
description: LTR1 high-level path that opens the master safety relay chain.
failureEffect: LTR1 high level or false high-level fault drops CR407.
firstCheck: Verify actual LTR1 level, then FS5081.

title: Evis M/U Air NH3 Shutdown
description: NH3 detector output path that affects Evis make-up air shutdown.
failureEffect: Evis M/U air units lose permissive or show shutdown condition.

title: Cooler M/U Air NH3 Shutdown
description: NH3 detector output path that affects Cooler make-up air shutdown.
failureEffect: Cooler M/U air unit loses permissive or shows shutdown condition.

title: Debone M/U Air NH3 Shutdown
description: NH3 detector output path that affects Debone make-up air shutdown.
failureEffect: Debone M/U air unit loses permissive or shows shutdown condition.

title: Engine Room Ventilation NH3 Command
description: NH3 detector output path that commands or affects engine room high ventilation logic.
failureEffect: High ventilation interlock fault or commanded ventilation state.

title: CP-01 Will Not Start Chain
description: Safety permissive path for CP-01 compressor start.
firstCheck: Check 120 VAC at Wire 5231, then Wire 5232.

title: SC-01 Will Not Start Chain
description: Safety permissive path for SC-01 compressor start.
firstCheck: Check 120 VAC at Wire 5241, then Wire 5242.

firstCheck: Check 120 VAC at Wire 5251, then Wire 5252.

firstCheck: Check 120 VAC at Wire 5261, then Wire 5262.

firstCheck: Check 120 VAC at Wire 5271, then Wire 5272.
